'''22D-R''' was a [[Commando Leader Captain]] affiliated with the [[Trade Federation Droid Army|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation]].<ref name="Insiders" /> During the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]<ref name="Insiders" /> in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> 22D-R assisted the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droid]], [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]], who was leading the [[droid]] [[army]]. Following the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s [[Escape from the Saak'ak|escape]] from the Trade Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|battleship]], OOM-9 searched for Kenobi on the surface of Naboo. The [[battle droid]] ordered 22D-R to release [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|remote seekers]] to hunt for Kenobi prior to their [[Capture of Theed|attack]] on the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[city]] [[Theed]]. One of the remote seekers followed Kenobi to the [[Water|underwater]] [[Gungan]] city [[Otoh Gunga]], where it was cut down by the [[Jedi]].<ref name="Insiders" />

==Behind the scenes==
22D-R was created for the revised rough draft of the [[prequel trilogy]] film {{Film|I}}, written by [[George Lucas]]. The character was ultimately cut from the finished film, and their role in the film was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'', a [[1999]] CD-ROM.<ref name="Insiders" />
